email.description: Email address receiving the organization invitation.

email_normalized.description: Lowercase, trimmed copy of the invited email used for reliable matching when the person registers or accepts.

target_user_id.description: Registered User ID once the invitation is matched to an existing or newly registered user.

organization_role_ids.description: OrganizationRole IDs to assign when the invitation is accepted. These roles determine organization-scoped permissions.

invitation_context.description: Workflow context only. It does not grant access by itself. CE training invitations use ce_training_enrollment.

invitation_status.description: Current lifecycle state of the organization invitation.

invited_by_user_id.description: User ID of the person who created the invitation.

invited_by_membership_id.description: OrganizationMembership ID for the inviter within this organization, when applicable.

invited_at.description: ISO timestamp when the invitation was created.

expires_at.description: ISO timestamp when the invitation expires.

accepted_at.description: ISO timestamp when the invitation was accepted.

accepted_membership_id.description: OrganizationMembership ID created or activated when this invitation is accepted.

message.description: Optional invitation message shown to the recipient.
